verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows LobeChat/LobeHub features around MCP connectors, agent building, self-hosting, and SSO, but nothing about container/VM sandboxing, tool permission policies, or scoped access controls limiting what an agent/tool can touch. No mention of sandboxed execution environments, allow/deny tool policies, or permission modes for risky tool runs. missing for 10: sandboxed/isolated execution environment for tools, granular tool permission policies, permission modes limiting agent capabilities, any documentation or independent evidence of containment controls.
